# Beacon Attorneys & Consultants

Beacon Attorneys & Consultants is a business law firm based in Kigali, Rwanda. The firm advises businesses, institutions, investors, and international clients across corporate, commercial, regulatory, transactional, and dispute matters.

Canonical website: https://www.beaconattorneys.rw/

- About the firm: https://www.beaconattorneys.rw/about
- Our people: https://www.beaconattorneys.rw/our-people

- Our approach: https://www.beaconattorneys.rw/our-approach
- Research and development: https://www.beaconattorneys.rw/research
- Contact: https://www.beaconattorneys.rw/contact
